findings.evidence: TauCeti/Data/Nat/ReciprocalSum.lean:9 `import Mathlib.Tactic`; the file's only declaration is `two_le_of_inv_add_inv_add_inv_lt_one`, whose proof is five lines.
findings.fix: Replace with the specific modules the proof needs, e.g. `Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith`, `Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity.Basic`, `Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum.Basic`, `Mathlib.Tactic.Omega` (plus a `Mathlib.Data.Rat.Order`-level import for the ordered-field lemmas).
findings.issue: `import Mathlib.Tactic` is the catch-all tactic module, transitively pulling in a large fraction of Mathlib for a three-line proof that only uses `by_contra`/`omega`/`positivity`/`norm_num`/`linarith`.

findings.evidence: `grep -r '^import Mathlib\.Analysis' mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix` returns no matches — Mathlib keeps that directory analysis-free. Trace/FinTwo.lean:8 and ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup/OrderOf.lean:8 both `public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic`, while Trace/FinTwo.lean:67,80,134,146,165 and OrderOf.lean:75 state results over an arbitrary `CommRing`.
findings.fix: Keep `Trace/FinTwo.lean` and `ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup/OrderOf.lean` analysis-free (CommRing + ordered-ring lemmas only) and move the trig-dependent `sin_smul_pow_fin_two`, `pow_eq_neg_one_of_trace_eq_two_mul_cos_pi_div` and `mk_pow_eq_one_of_trace_sq_eq` into an analysis-level module, e.g. `TauCeti/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Trigonometric/MatrixFinTwo.lean` beside the new `PiDiv.lean`; this also removes the `LinearAlgebra → TauCeti.Analysis...PiDiv` import at Trace/FinTwo.lean:12.
findings.issue: ℝ-trigonometric declarations live in `LinearAlgebra/Matrix/`, so `Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic` becomes a public import of modules that also carry ring-general results: `sin_smul_pow_fin_two` (line 89) and `pow_eq_neg_one_of_trace_eq_two_mul_cos_pi_div` (line 117) sit beside the `CommRing`-general `pow_add_two_fin_two`, `trace_pow_add_two_fin_two`, `two_lt_trace_pow`, `two_lt_abs_trace_pow` and the Fricke identity, and the same happens in `ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup/OrderOf.lean:8`, where the ring-general `not_isOfFinOrder_mk_of_two_lt_abs_trace` is forced to depend on real trigonometry via `mk_pow_eq_one_of_trace_sq_eq`. A future user of Cayley–Hamilton or Fricke over ℤ or a finite field then imports real analysis.

summary: Two placement/import problems: a catch-all `import Mathlib.Tactic` in the new `Data/Nat/ReciprocalSum.lean`, and ℝ-trigonometric lemmas placed under `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/`, which forces a public analysis import onto the ring-general trace results in the same modules. Everything else (the `Trace/` directory conversion with all importers updated, the `TriangleGroup/Hyperbolic.lean` and `ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup/OrderOf.lean` homes) is in the right place.
